decision: Accept the verified optional SDK boundary with the measured native-start regression explicitly retained as optimization work. Do not claim overall speedup.
conclusion: Final callback-corrected mixed queries are 3.59–4.17% faster than v0.26 in two desktop runs. Native query/cast-start work is 1.37–2.63% slower. Against the original, mixed queries are 0.89–1.85% slower and native starts 2.50–7.68% slower. This extraction is not an overall performance improvement. No allocation, whole-frame or device claim.
limits: Two rotating desktop Node runs. Current/original/previous gameplay receipts match exactly. No whole-frame, physical Steam Deck, mobile, allocation/GC or energy claim.
supersedes: Earlier candidate measurements at commit 098ff62273016da5cc4eda64ada196592f4ae481 precede two callback-order corrections. The two published sample files now contain final corrected-runtime measurements.
followup: Profile complete native request dispatch and its host/SDK transitions before changing caches or callback semantics; retain receipt checks and measure allocation/frame/device costs separately.
